content.text_value: Cloud Cost Crisis: An Executive Brief
SCQA framing for the FY26 strategy review
Why we are recommending a FinOps reset

values.situation: Cloud spend grew 38% YoY across the portfolio in FY25.
complication: Unit economics flattened as workloads scaled, eroding gross margin.
Finance projects an additional 22% increase if usage trends hold.
questions: Where can we reclaim margin without slowing the roadmap?
What governance keeps the savings durable?
answer: Right-size the top 10 workloads to recover 14% of FY26 spend.
Stand up a FinOps council with monthly accountability reviews.
Reinvest 30% of the savings into platform reliability.

callout.text: Target: $4.8M FY26 run-rate savings, locked in by Q1 close.

values.situation: The team ships weekly with high quality.
values.complication: Customer onboarding has not kept pace.
